text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's Umamusume quiz time! Our questions
will
cover everything from histories to
hobbies. Are
you ready to be tested on
your Uma knowledge?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Our love of Umamusume is the number
one thing
the two of us have in common,
right?
choice_data_list: What is it, all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yet, I'm the only one who ever shares my

thoughts! I never see you nerd out... like
ever.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Then I realized why. It's because...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I can be a little much, right?! It must be
hard for
you to pitch in when I'm being
so loud all the
time!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: If so, then know that I'm so sorry! I want you to be able to express your joy when you feel like it too!
choice_data_list: (It's true she yells a lot, but...)
(It's true she yells a lot, though...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So, if possible, I wanna know all about
what you
look for in your oshis! I wanna
simp over them
with you! We shouldn't
keep our passions to
ourselves! We have
to share!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's when I came up with the idea that
an
Umamusume quiz might help loosen
up your
tongue!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
This isn't about finding out who's the
best or
anything like that! It's about
sharing! Think of it
like one of those
Umatter updates they do
sometimes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In other words, she's manufacturing an

opportunity for us to have a fun
discussion about
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So, are you ready?! Let's get started! In
three,
two, one!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah! This one is multiple choice!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Isn't Taiki Shuttle such a powerful,
fantastic,
beautiful, and wonderful
Umamusume?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
She was born and raised on American
soil, but
which state is she from? Is it
Kentucky or Texas?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Trainer! Let your explosive love
for
Umamusume ignite!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Woohooo! That... is... CORRECT!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Do you think it's their delicious fried
chicken that
produced her beaming,
beautiful smile? There's
gotta be some
connection.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Splendid work, Trainer! You're doing us
Uma
simps proud!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All right, hold onto that energy, 'cause
now I
wanna move onto oshi talk!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Who are you simping for recently? Ah,
wait... that
sounds a little disrespectful
to the oshis you've
been simping for up
until now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Which also can't be right... right? We
love all our
oshis equally—it's just,
sometimes, certain ones
take the
spotlight partly 'cause of their sparkle...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a result of the sudden quiz, Agnes
Digital
begins speaking with gusto.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh! Too bad! Sorry to say, but that is incorrect.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's okay, though! We all make
mistakes!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What's important is what you do after!
So,
remember what happened here when
you go
home today, m'kay! And then,
you can dip your
toe back into hardcore
simping!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I'll have to up my Uma
knowledge if I
want to try and keep up
with Agnes Digital.
